# RecallDB — U.S. Product Recall Database (Sample)

> **Full dataset:** [recalldb.dataengineered.io](https://recalldb.dataengineered.io/) · **$49 one-time** snapshot → [Buy on Stripe](https://buy.stripe.com/aFacN69Jm2MK8rN5Uk38408) · the same sample on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Ichlibitiche/recalldb-product-recalls-sample)
**128,936 official recalls · 294,683 recalled products · CPSC · FDA · FSIS · NHTSA · USCG · 100% source-linked**

RecallDB is a normalized, provenance-tracked dataset of official U.S. federal product recalls. It joins five official source families into one CSV/SQLite model: CPSC consumer products, NHTSA vehicles, FDA/openFDA plus FDA Safety Alerts enrichment, USDA FSIS food safety recalls, and USCG recreational boating recalls.

**Full dataset & documentation:** https://recalldb.dataengineered.io/

## Public sample vs paid full dataset

This Kaggle dataset is the **free public sample**. The full CSV + SQLite export is not published here.

| Table | Full dataset | Public sample |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| Recalls | 128,936 | 200 |
| Recalled products | 294,683 | 428 |
| Source pulls | 519 | 11 |
| Firms | 21,054 | 147 |
| Hazard taxonomy | 11 | 11 |

## Files in this sample

- `recalls.csv` — balanced sample of recalls from all five agencies
- `recalled_products.csv` — linked products, vehicles, lots and categories
- `data_sources.csv` — endpoint URLs, retrieval timestamps and raw payload hashes
- `firms.csv` — canonical firm names observed in the sample
- `hazards.csv` — hazard taxonomy with recall counts

## Provenance

Every recall carries `source_agency`, `external_id`, `source_url`, and `source_id`. `source_id` joins into `data_sources.csv`, which exposes `endpoint_url`, `retrieved_at`, `raw_payload_bytes`, and `raw_payload_sha256`. The paid SQLite release also stores the archived raw payload for replay and audit.

## Source coverage

| Agency | Full rows | Domain |
| :--- | ---: | :--- |
| CPSC | 8,304 | Consumer product recalls |
| FDA | 87,387 | Food, drugs, devices, cosmetics, biologics, animal/veterinary alerts |
| FSIS | 1,236 | Meat, poultry and egg product recalls |
| NHTSA | 30,316 | Vehicle and equipment recalls |
| USCG | 1,693 | Recreational boating recalls |

EPA is intentionally excluded from v1 (no stable official recall-specific structured feed was identified).

## Quick start

```python
import pandas as pd

recalls = pd.read_csv("/kaggle/input/recalldb-product-recalls-sample/recalls.csv")
recalls.groupby("source_agency").size().sort_values(ascending=False)
```

fields.name: recall_id
fields.description: RecallDB surrogate key for the recall. Joins recalled_products.csv.

fields.name: source_agency
fields.description: Agency that published the recall: CPSC, FDA, FSIS, NHTSA or USCG.

fields.name: external_id
fields.description: Agency-native recall identifier (CPSC recall number, NHTSA campaign number, FDA recall number or namespaced FDA alert id, FSIS or USCG recall number). Unique with source_agency.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Source pull that produced the recall. Joins data_sources.csv.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Agency-published recall title or product headline.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Agency-published recall reason, summary or hazard text. Empty when the agency publishes none (USCG since Aug-Sep 2026).

fields.name: recalling_firm_canonical
fields.description: Normalized firm key (lowercased, punctuation and legal suffixes removed) used to match one firm across agencies. Joins firms.csv canonical_name.

fields.name: recalling_firm_display
fields.description: Recalling firm as spelled in the source. NHTSA: the manufacturer that filed the recall.

fields.name: recall_date
fields.description: Recall initiation or publication date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Agency classification where published: FDA Class I/II/III, FSIS risk class (e.g. High - Class I) or Public Health Alert, NHTSA do_not_drive / park_outside flags. Empty for CPSC and USCG.

fields.name: remedy
fields.description: Agency-published remedy: refund, repair, replace, dispose or the agency's instructions.

fields.name: units_affected
fields.description: Agency-published number of affected units. Empty when the agency does not publish one.

fields.name: distribution_pattern
fields.description: Agency-published geography or distribution pattern.

fields.name: hazard_keys
fields.description: Pipe-delimited hazard taxonomy keys assigned to the recall (see hazards.csv).

fields.name: raw_hazard_texts
fields.description: Pipe-delimited original hazard phrases the keys were mapped from.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Record-level agency web page or API lookup URL for this recall.

fields.name: source_endpoint_url
fields.description: Exact API, download or page URL whose archived payload produced the row.

fields.name: retrieved_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when that source payload was retrieved and archived.

fields.name: product_id
fields.description: RecallDB surrogate key for the recalled product row.

fields.name: recall_id
fields.description: Parent recall. Joins recalls.csv.

fields.name: source_agency
fields.description: Agency of the parent recall.

fields.name: external_id
fields.description: Agency-native id of the parent recall. NHTSA: the campaign number, whose third character is the recall type (V vehicle, E equipment, T tire, C child seat).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Agency-published product, SKU, lot or vehicle name. NHTSA: make, model and model year joined as published, so an unknown year reads 9999.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Product brand when the agency publishes it separately. NHTSA: the vehicle or equipment make (MAKETXT), not the recalling manufacturer; upfitted vehicles name the upfitter (e.g. BRAUN).

fields.name: model_number
fields.description: Agency-published model, SKU or equivalent identifier. NHTSA: the vehicle or equipment model (MODELTXT), as published.

fields.name: upc
fields.description: Checksum-valid UPC-A extracted from agency text. Empty when none is published.

fields.name: lot_codes
fields.description: Agency-published lot, code, serial or batch text. NHTSA: the recalled component id.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Normalized category: consumer_product, vehicle, food, drug, device, boat, cosmetic, animal_veterinary and similar.

fields.name: model_year
fields.description: Agency-published model year: NHTSA vehicles and equipment (9999 = unknown becomes empty) and USCG boats.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: RecallDB surrogate key for one archived source pull. Joined from recalls.csv source_id.

fields.name: source_agency
fields.description: Agency whose data the pull fetched.

fields.name: endpoint_url
fields.description: Exact official API URL, download URL, list or detail page that was fetched.

fields.name: retrieved_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when the payload was retrieved and archived.

fields.name: raw_payload_bytes
fields.description: Size in bytes of the raw payload archived in the full database.

fields.name: raw_payload_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the archived raw payload, for audit and replay checks.

fields.name: firm_id
fields.description: RecallDB surrogate key for a canonicalized firm.

fields.name: canonical_name
fields.description: Normalized firm key (lowercased, punctuation and legal suffixes removed). Joins recalls.csv recalling_firm_canonical.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Best-known original spelling of the firm.

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: Pipe-delimited original spellings of the firm seen in source records.

fields.name: hazard_key
fields.description: Hazard taxonomy key used in recalls.csv hazard_keys (fire_burn, crash_injury, microbial_contamination, ...).

fields.name: description
fields.description: Plain-language meaning of the hazard key.

fields.name: recall_count
fields.description: Number of recalls carrying this hazard key in the full release (not in this sample).
